module: "general" settings provider of the multiseat settings window. It declares the fields: same vehicle for everyone, gather vehicles, reseat all players, automatic color, player markers and split screen layout for 2 to 9+ players; then it handles their actions, changes, validation and application via the onXxxMultiseatGameSetting(s) hooks.
notes: Settings written to settings: multiseatAutomaticColor and multiseatLayout2 to multiseatLayout9 (9 = "9+", only the value "automatic" is accepted). The multiseatTags setting (markers) is written immediately (applyMode = immediate).
A stored "shared" layout is converted to "automatic" for display and refused at validation.
Validation refusal reasons: missing_general_multiseat_settings, invalid_player_marker_mode, invalid_automatic_color_mode, invalid_multiseat_layout.
After application, the fields gatherVehicles and reseatAllPlayers are reset to their neutral value ("" and false) via result.valueOverrides.

onGetMultiseatGameSettings.desc: Adds the "general" provider (placement afterVehicles, applyMode apply) with all its fields to providers.

providers.desc: List of settings providers to complete.

onMultiseatGameSettingAction.desc: Handles the action of the sameVehicleForEveryone field: "selector" opens the vehicle selector for all players, otherwise the chosen vehicle is staged for all. The result is written to result.success. Ignored for other providers.

onMultiseatGameSettingChanged.desc: Reacts to a field change: automaticColor is staged for all players; showPlayerMarkers is applied immediately (core_multiseat.setPlayerMarkersEnabled, otherwise the multiseatTags setting).

onValidateMultiseatGameSettings.desc: Validates the staged settings: provider presence, boolean showPlayerMarkers and automaticColor, valid layouts for each player count. Writes result.success = false and result.reason on error.

onApplyMultiseatGameSettings.desc: Saves automatic color and layouts, refreshes render_splitScreen, gathers the vehicles (gatherVehicles) and reseats the players (reseatAllPlayers) if requested, then resets these two fields to zero via result.valueOverrides.
